The PR title is the squash commit and the release input. Use Conventional Commits:

  feat!: …  or "BREAKING CHANGE:" below → major
  docs: / test: / ci: / build: / refactor: / chore: → no release
A change to a shipped file of a Claude Code plugin always gives at least a patch.
The version job writes the version files; do not edit them by hand.
